verdict.rationale: Evidence only offers a generic marketing-style statement that Veriff's 'Biometric Liveness' solution 'ensures biometric data is from a live person' and 'reduces fraud risk' — no named detection capabilities (e.g., anti-spoofing models, deepfake detection, camera-injection detection, presentation attack detection) are documented. missing for 10: named defenses against AI-generated faces, deepfake detection specifics, camera-injection/virtual-camera attack detection, any technical description of the liveness detection methodology.
